summary: M3.15 PASSES QA. All 6 spec items (EB.3 axc bench subcommand, the lexer-anchored strip_strategy_annotation_block fix, EB.4 two-key baseline re-bless + round-trip test, AT-103 golden full-byte upgrade, CHANGELOG.md backfill, doc-accuracy sweep) are present in the diff exactly as r3 specifies, with all 15 acceptance tests (AT-2826..2840) passing. cargo build/clippy(-D warnings)/test all clean: 1036 passed, 0 failed, 112 ignored (full recount from an untruncated log, matching the coder's claim exactly — the QA agent's first `cargo test` capture had been accidentally truncated by a `tail -80` pipe and was corrected by re-running to a file). Independently regenerated the empty-kernel SPIR-V golden via the built axc binary and confirmed byte-for-byte identity with `cmp` (not just the test's own assertion). Independently wrote and ran two adversarial decoy fixtures beyond the spec's own AT-2830/2831 (a combined comment+intent-prose decoy with a real block later in the same file, and a brace-adjacent comment decoy) against the actual strip_strategy_annotation_block function (temporarily inlined into lib.rs's test module, then fully reverted — git diff on lib.rs confirmed clean) — both passed, no gap found beyond what the spec's fixtures already cover. Ran the real GPU dispatch smoke suite on the present NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 hardware: 4/4 pass. Confirmed scope discipline: zero touches to axc-lexer/parser/hir/mir/codegen crates or examples/*.axc, and zero touches to ci.yml, BENCHMARKS.md:230, or the two axc-runtime ICD doc-comments (all correctly left CI-canonical per the r3 reversal). All 3 coder-documented deviations were independently checked against their claimed justifications (AT-1043/1044 precedent, the 5-bench postprocess.rs KNOWN_BENCHES scoping, and the frozen-value re-pin being the spec's own anticipated consequence) and found accurate — no scope creep, no weakened assertions, no undisclosed gaps. Recommend proceeding to code review.
